text.tspan: Malaria deaths: IHME vs. WHO estimates 2023
Annual number of deaths from malaria sourced from the IHME's Global Burden of Disease versus estimates
from the World Health Organization. Shown is a line of parity; if estimates between IHME and WHO data
matched, points would lie along this line.
Malaria deaths (WHO estimates) (deaths; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Malaria deaths (IHME estimates) (deaths; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025); World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory (2026)
